headline: What am I doing wrong that he won't commit?
note: Wired 2026-08-25 from fb-tarot/docs/drafts/shadow/REVIEW-money-alone-commit-2026-08-25.md — approved copy, transferred verbatim. Reuses the existing default decode-him frame; no new guard.

a: You turned the Magician. The cards were face down, but your hand found the one who came with everything ready.
The cup, coin, blade and wand are all out on his table.
You asked what you are doing wrong because he will not commit. What catches me is that nothing on the table is missing.
He has not committed, and the question has turned his decision back on you.
I keep coming back to something between the complete table and his commitment. I don't think it began with you.
Let me look closer at what's behind this…
b: You turned the Hanged Man. Nothing revealed him, yet you chose the one held by a single thing.
One rope circles one ankle. The rest of him hangs free.
You asked what in you explains his lack of commitment. This card brings me to the one rope.
Still, the future is held, and you are asking whether you caused it.
Something is holding his decision tightly. I don't think this began with you.
Let me see what's holding his decision…
c: You turned the Fool. You couldn't see the picture, but your hand went to the one who began without carrying everything.
One small bundle is all he takes with him.
You asked what you did wrong. The small bundle at the beginning is where this card takes me.
But the commitment has not begun, and you are searching yourself for the reason.
At the point where the future would begin to settle, something appears. I don't think it started with you.
Now let's look at what's behind this…
